3PLd7Q: The information above is used only for: sign-in and identity recognition; verifying your membership of the Discord server bound to a guild; team signups; departure reminders and app push notifications; heirloom-achievement pushes; and displaying the site in your preferred language. 43OqWT: This site runs on Cloudflare infrastructure, and its data is stored in Cloudflare’s database services. Sign-in and membership verification are provided by Discord. Mobile push notifications are relayed by the Expo push service to Apple’s or Google’s push channels. Departure reminders and heirloom messages are posted to the Discord channel configured by the relevant guild’s administrator, and those messages include your in-game nickname. Apart from what is necessary for the functions above, we do not provide your personal data to other third parties, except where required by law.
1abLW7: Your data is kept in this site’s database until you request its deletion or it is no longer needed for the site’s functions. Historical records such as signups and teams are currently retained on an ongoing basis; if our retention practices change, we will update this policy.
1uyGts: You can access, export or delete your personal data. Under “My data” in your Profile, you can export all of your data yourself (a fresh Discord authorization check is required; one export per 24 hours), and you can delete your account yourself: after you submit a deletion there is a 7-day cooling-off period during which you may cancel at any time; once it ends, your personal data is deleted or anonymized — squads you created become leaderless squads, seats you hold in other people’s squads are anonymized, and copies inside backups are cleared within 14 days as daily backups rotate. You may also disconnect this site’s authorization at any time in your Discord settings; once the authorization lapses, your session on this site is automatically invalidated.
